subject: ApexBio GCP Private Offer — evaluation checkpoints & procurement runway
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy@apexbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ApexBio GCP Private Offer — evaluation checkpoints & procurement runway

Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for the time on Wednesday. Per our call, I wanted to put a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) and evaluation cadence on paper so your procurement and engineering teams have a clear path to a private-offer purchase on GCP. This is a pragmatic, staged approach so you can validate performance + cost before committing to reserved capacity.

High-level ask: can you share the expected procurement timeline (PO approver name & cadence) so we can align licensing/billing milestones?

Proposed MAP and eval checkpoints (suggested dates are tentative):
- Week 0 (May 18): Kickoff + account setup — access to sandbox GCP project, test credentials.
- Week 1 (May 18–25): Smoke tests — end-to-end generation, latency baselines, prefix caching validation.
- Week 2 (May 25–Jun 1): Load / throughput test — simulated concurrent users (50–200 reqs/s), cost estimates gathered.
- Week 3 (Jun 1–8): Quality review + model selection — side-by-side with your test prompts; pick model variant and quantization profile.
- Week 4 (Jun 8–15): Procurement signoff & PO issuance — transition to private-offer billing on GCP.

Billing path options we discussed:
- Option A (Preferred): GCP Private Offer via Cloud Marketplace — Redwood issues private-offer contract, invoices flow through the Marketplace purchase path (monthly invoices to ApexBio AP). Advantages: single-pane billing in GCP, support for consolidated billing.
- Option B: Direct Redwood invoice (for initial POC) and then move to private offer for production commit.

Attached: draft MAP (MAP-draft-APEX-2026.xlsx) and pricing snapshot (RDW-Apex-pricing-v3.pdf).

If procurement wants a specific PO template or vendor form, loop them onto this thread and cc: procurement@apexbio.com.

Next steps: can you confirm PO approver and target week for PO issuance? Also, is SOC 2 evidence required before PO?

Thanks — happy to sync with procurement live if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lucy Chen <lucy@apexbio.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: ApexBio Procurement <procurement@apexbio.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ApexBio GCP Private Offer — evaluation checkpoints & procurement runway

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the tidy plan — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement timeline: we have a weekly vendor review meeting on Tuesdays. Target approver for POs is Maria Alvarez (VP Finance). Realistically we can issue a PO by the week of Jun 8 if the MAP shows clear perf/cost.

2) Billing preference: we strongly prefer the GCP Private Offer path (Option A) so charges show up in our cloud billing. Can you confirm Redwood can accept private-offer terms that include monthly billing and net-30 payment?

3) SOC 2: we need SOC 2 Type II report for all vendors before production access. For initial eval in our sandbox, a self-attestation plus the SOC 2 artifact is acceptable.

4) Procurement team asks: please provide an example GCP private-offer purchase order flow (one-page) that we can attach to our vendor packet. Also, can you provide an expected invoice cadence and the legal entity name for Redwood?

Cc'ing procurement mailbox to keep them in the loop.

Thanks,
Lucy
Lucy Chen
Sr. Cloud Engineer, Platform
ApexBio

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy@apexbio.com>, ApexBio Procurement <procurement@apexbio.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ApexBio GCP Private Offer — evaluation checkpoints & procurement runway

Hi Lucy / Procurement team —

Appreciate the quick reply. Short answers below and an example flow attached.

- Private Offer & net-30: Yes — Redwood can accept Private Offer terms with monthly billing and net-30 payment under Redwood Inference, Inc. (legal entity and W-9 attached in the procurement packet).
- Invoice cadence: monthly, with line items rolled up by region and model family. For the POC we can provide a weekly cost snapshot so you have visibility into consumption during load tests.
- Example purchase flow (one-pager): see attached (RDW-Apex-pricing-v3.pdf) and the MAP spreadsheet we use for milestone signoff (MAP-draft-APEX-2026.xlsx).
- SOC 2: we will share the SOC 2 Type II report via a secure link (I can share to your SSO or preferred upload). For sandbox eval, we will provide a short self-attestation and create a read-only access window.

Procurement checklist (recommended minimal steps):
1) Redlined PO template received from ApexBio -> Redwood legal review (2–3 business days)
2) Redwood issues Private Offer in GCP Marketplace (1–2 business days after legal signoff)
3) Apex submits PO referencing the Private Offer ID -> Redwood acknowledges (same day)
4) GCP bill mapping validated (first invoice cycle) -> AP validation and payment (Net-30)

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute onboarding with your AP team next week (Tue 18th slot open 10–11am PT).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Marketplace Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Lucy / Maria / Procurement team —

Great — thanks for confirming the approver and preference for Private Offer. To keep momentum, here's an agreed short checklist and dates we all committed to on the call:

Agreed MAP milestones (confirmed):
- May 18: Sandbox access provided (complete) — Aditya confirmed credentials delivered.
- May 18–25: Smoke tests (engineering) — Lucy to share results doc by May 26.
- May 25–Jun 1: Load test window — Redwood will run scheduled load tests on May 27 and May 29; weekly cost snapshots to be shared May 28.
- Jun 1–8: Quality review & selection — joint session on Jun 3 to pick model variant.
- Jun 8: Procurement signoff target — Maria Alvarez to issue PO referencing Private Offer ID.

Action items (owners):
- Lucy: upload smoke test results to the shared Drive folder (link below) by 26 May.
- Ben: Draft Private Offer ID + one-page purchase flow and share to procurement by May 20. (Attachment: RDW-Apex-pricing-v3.pdf)
- Aditya: Provide SOC 2 upload link and short self-attestation doc by May 19.
- Maria / Procurement: Send PO template or vendor attachment requirements if any deviations from our example.

If the PO timeline slips beyond Jun 15, we will recommend a short extension for the private-offer pricing to remain valid; we'll flag any material price updates.

Shared links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/munual-action-plan-apex-2026 and HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/847291

If everyone is aligned, I'll book the Jun 3 model selection call and the May 27 load test window.

Thanks all — small, concrete steps and we should be able to close cleanly the week of Jun 8.

Best,
Hannah
